caseNameFull: Rockefeller, Governor of New York v. Socialist Workers Party
judges: Affirmance, Are, From, Harlan, Noted, Set, Should, Stewart

opinions.text:
Affirmed on appeal from D. C. S. D. N. Y. Stay order of KIr. Justice Harlan vacated.

The Chief Justice, Mr. Justice Harlan; and Mr. Justice Stewart dissent from the affirmance of the' judgment and are of the opinion that probable jurisdiction should be noted and the case set. for oral argument.
